text:
maria: heads up — multiple Trivy runs timed out on GH runners around 03:12 UTC, looks correlated with KMS decrypt failures in the trivy cache step. anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
jamal: saw alerts, grabbing logs now. can you paste the runner job id?
maria: job: run-2026-03-05-11723
scanner-bot: GHAS scan failed: exit code 143
scanner-bot: logs: "error: failed to decrypt cache object: AccessDeniedException: Forbidden\ncaused by: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/github-runner-role/session is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef..."
sam: that smells like the RBAC change from yesterday — we removed kms:Decrypt for the runner role when tightening key policy
eva: hmm, did we add an encryption context condition? that can block cross-account decrypts
maria: good call. current key policy snippet:
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowUsage",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/github-runner-role"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": {"kms:EncryptionContext:project": "redwood-ci"}
  }
}
```
jamal: runners don't set that EncryptionContext so Decrypt fails. quick fix: add kms:ViaService or relax the EncryptionContext conditional for the runner principal
maria: OK, two options: 1) revert yesterday's policy change (fast), 2) update policy to include Runner principal without condition (safe enough short-term). which do we want?
sam: prefer #2 with explicit principal allow; I'll open a terraform PR and a revert-ready rollback PR
eva: also need to check Snyk and Trivy suppression sync — some scanner workers read cached DB from S3, if cache restore fails scans re-run and blow up pipeline
maria: created ticket SEC-2026-45 and linked the failing job logs. assigning to @sam and @jamal. I'll post the PR in this thread
sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789 — adds runner kms decrypt allow and documents the encryptioncontext for deploys :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment plan for infra PR #789 created — no drift detected
jamal: applied to staging, re-triggered GHAS jobs, all scans passed on re-run :tada:
maria: rolling to prod after 10m verification window. will create a follow-up to audit all key policies for encryption context assumptions
eva: reminder: update suppression mapping doc for Trivy->GHAS->Snyk orchestration so we don't mask real failures
maria: thanks everyone — closing thread once prod is green
scanner-bot: scan-runner: job run-2026-03-05-11723 now marked resolved
maria: last check — prod jobs green at 03:30 UTC, closing. /cc @security on-call
